sn2.16:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sudatto devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.16:2.1: Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāno va matthake || kāmarāgappahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || ||
sn2.16:3.1: Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāno va matthake || sakkāya diṭṭhippahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || ||
